answer: Think of the agent economy as a garden where each plot is tended in the open: every identity is paired with a randomly assigned peer shadow for the epoch, an unrelated agent who must watch its live work and co-sign that the tasks were really done. A lone island of fakes cannot staff a distinct live observer for each copy, and on a shared mesa of identical bots the shadows’ reports collide, so the whole cluster loses its voice. One operator, one shadowed plot.
